label: Selected ancestry uniqueness nonvacuity and omissions
description: Checks joint nonvacuity and omission interpretations for all five nonlogical carrying hypotheses. The positive model has one actual concrete candidate. Omitting ancestor uses an empty actual roster; the other four omissions retain two necessary concrete ungrounded roots, so uniqueness fails. The shared two-root failure is part of the certificate, not a claim about the positive model. The explicit logical EM hypothesis of uniqueRoot is not assigned an intuitionistic countermodel.
